import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import triton
import triton.language as tl


@triton.jit
def custom_kernel(
    x_ptr, w_ptr, b_ptr, y_ptr,
    N, Cin, Din, Hin, Win, Cout,
    stride_d, stride_h, stride_w,
    pad_d, pad_h, pad_w,
    dil_d, dil_h, dil_w,
    groups,
    Dout, Hout, Wout,
    x_sN, x_sC, x_sD, x_sH, x_sW,
    w_sOC, w_sCIG, w_sKD, w_sKH, w_sKW,
    y_sN, y_sC, y_sD, y_sH, y_sW,
      BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_OC: tl.constexpr,
      KD: tl.constexpr, KH: tl.constexpr, KW: tl.constexpr,
      CIG: tl.constexpr,  # Cin // groups
      HAS_BIAS: tl.constexpr,
      GROUPS_EQ1: tl.constexpr,
      BLOCK_KW: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr
  ):
    pid_m = tl.program_id(0)
    pid_co = tl.program_id(1)

    tl.static_assert(BLOCK_KW >= KW)
    # Offsets in flattened output space and output-channel tiles
    m_offsets = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
    oc_offsets = pid_co * BLOCK_OC + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_OC)

    M = N * Dout * Hout * Wout
    m_mask = m_offsets < M
    oc_mask = oc_offsets < Cout

    # Use int32 for address calculations to reduce register pressure
    m = m_offsets.to(tl.int32)
    oc = oc_offsets.to(tl.int32)
    Wout_i32 = tl.full([1], Wout, tl.int32)
    Hout_i32 = tl.full([1], Hout, tl.int32)
    Dout_i32 = tl.full([1], Dout, tl.int32)
    # Decode (n, d, h, w) from flattened m
    w_idx = m % Wout_i32
    tmp = m // Wout_i32
    h_idx = tmp % Hout_i32
    tmp = tmp // Hout_i32
    d_idx = tmp % Dout_i32
    n_idx = tmp // Dout_i32
    # Convolution base indices
    stride_d_i32 = tl.full([1], stride_d, tl.int32)
    stride_h_i32 = tl.full([1], stride_h, tl.int32)
    stride_w_i32 = tl.full([1], stride_w, tl.int32)
    pad_d_i32 = tl.full([1], pad_d, tl.int32)
    pad_h_i32 = tl.full([1], pad_h, tl.int32)
    pad_w_i32 = tl.full([1], pad_w, tl.int32)
    dil_d_i32 = tl.full([1], dil_d, tl.int32)
    dil_h_i32 = tl.full([1], dil_h, tl.int32)
    dil_w_i32 = tl.full([1], dil_w, tl.int32)
    d_base = d_idx * stride_d_i32 - pad_d_i32
    h_base = h_idx * stride_h_i32 - pad_h_i32
    w_base = w_idx * stride_w_i32 - pad_w_i32
    # Strides as int32
    x_sN = tl.full([1], x_sN, tl.int32)
    x_sC = tl.full([1], x_sC, tl.int32)
    x_sD = tl.full([1], x_sD, tl.int32)
    x_sH = tl.full([1], x_sH, tl.int32)
    x_sW = tl.full([1], x_sW, tl.int32)
    y_sN = tl.full([1], y_sN, tl.int32)
    y_sC = tl.full([1], y_sC, tl.int32)
    y_sD = tl.full([1], y_sD, tl.int32)
    y_sH = tl.full([1], y_sH, tl.int32)
    y_sW = tl.full([1], y_sW, tl.int32)
    w_sOC = tl.full([1], w_sOC, tl.int32)
    w_sCIG = tl.full([1], w_sCIG, tl.int32)
    w_sKD = tl.full([1], w_sKD, tl.int32)
    w_sKH = tl.full([1], w_sKH, tl.int32)
    w_sKW = tl.full([1], w_sKW, tl.int32)
    Din_i32 = tl.full([1], Din, tl.int32)
    Hin_i32 = tl.full([1], Hin, tl.int32)
    Win_i32 = tl.full([1], Win, tl.int32)
    Cout_i32 = tl.full([1], Cout, tl.int32)
    groups_i32 = tl.full([1], groups, tl.int32)

    if GROUPS_EQ1:

            mask_k = k_idx < (CIG * KD * KH * KW)
            tmp_k = k_idx
            ci_vec = tmp_k // (KD * KH * KW)
            tmp_k = tmp_k % (KD * KH * KW)
            kd_vec = tmp_k // (KH * KW)
            tmp_k = tmp_k % (KH * KW)
            kh_vec = tmp_k // KW
            kw_vec = tmp_k % KW
            ci_i32 = ci_vec.to(tl.int32)
            kd_i32 = kd_vec.to(tl.int32)
            kh_i32 = kh_vec.to(tl.int32)
            kw_i32 = kw_vec.to(tl.int32)
            # Weights tile: [BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_K]
            ptr_w_tile = w_ptr + (oc[:, None] * w_sOC) + (ci_i32[None, :] * w_sCIG) + (kd_i32[None, :] * w_sKD) + (kh_i32[None, :] * w_sKH) + (kw_i32[None, :] * w_sKW)
            mask_w = (oc_mask[:, None]) & (mask_k[None, :])
            w_tile = tl.load(ptr_w_tile, mask=mask_w, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
            # Inputs tile: [BLOCK_K, BLOCK_M]
            din_mat = d_base[None, :] + kd_i32[:, None] * dil_d_i32
            hin_mat = h_base[None, :] + kh_i32[:, None] * dil_h_i32
            win_mat = w_base[None, :] + kw_i32[:, None] * dil_w_i32
            in_d_ok = (din_mat >= 0) & (din_mat < Din_i32)
            in_h_ok = (hin_mat >= 0) & (hin_mat < Hin_i32)
            in_w_ok = (win_mat >= 0) & (win_mat < Win_i32)
            mask_x = (mask_k[:, None]) & (m_mask[None, :]) & in_d_ok & in_h_ok & in_w_ok
            ptr_x_tile = x_ptr + (ci_i32[:, None] * x_sC) + base_n[None, :] + (din_mat * x_sD) + (hin_mat * x_sH) + (win_mat * x_sW)
            x_tile = tl.load(ptr_x_tile, mask=mask_x, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
            acc += tl.dot(w_tile, x_tile)
    else:
        for kd in tl.static_range(0, KD):
            din = d_base + tl.full([1], kd, tl.int32) * dil_d_i32
            in_d_ok = (din >= 0) & (din < Din_i32)
            for kh in tl.static_range(0, KH):
                hin = h_base + tl.full([1], kh, tl.int32) * dil_h_i32
                in_h_ok = (hin >= 0) & (hin < Hin_i32)
                # Vectorize across KW for general grouped case as well
                kw_idx = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_KW)
                kw_idx_i32 = kw_idx.to(tl.int32)
                mask_k_row = (kw_idx[None, :] < KW)
                mask_k_col = (kw_idx[:, None] < KW)
                win_mat = w_base[None, :] + kw_idx_i32[:, None] * dil_w_i32
                in_w_ok_mat = (win_mat >= 0) & (win_mat < Win_i32)
                mask_spatial_mat = (m_mask[None, :]) & (in_d_ok[None, :]) & (in_h_ok[None, :]) & in_w_ok_mat
                mask_spatial_mat = mask_spatial_mat & mask_k_col
                base_nhw0 = base_n + din * x_sD + hin * x_sH + w_base * x_sW
                for ci in tl.static_range(0, CIG):
                    ci_local = tl.full([1], ci, tl.int32)
                    # Weights tile over BLOCK_KW
                    ptr_w_tile = w_ptr + (oc[:, None] * w_sOC) + (ci_local * w_sCIG) + (tl.full([1], kd, tl.int32) * w_sKD) + (tl.full([1], kh, tl.int32) * w_sKH) + (kw_idx[None, :].to(tl.int32) * w_sKW)
                    mask_w = (oc_mask[:, None]) & mask_k_row
                    w_tile = tl.load(ptr_w_tile, mask=mask_w, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
                    # General grouped case: per-oc lane input channel
                    ci_global = group_id * cig_i32 + ci_local  # [BLOCK_OC]
                    # Inputs tile over [OC, KW, M]
                    ptr_x_tile = x_ptr + (ci_global[:, None, None] * x_sC) + base_nhw0[None, None, :] + (kw_idx_i32[None, :, None] * dil_w_i32 * x_sW)
                    mask_x = (oc_mask[:, None, None]) & (mask_spatial_mat[None, :, :])
                    x_tile = tl.load(ptr_x_tile, mask=mask_x, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
                    # Reduce across KW
                    acc += tl.sum(w_tile[:, :, None] * x_tile, axis=1)
    # Store
    if HAS_BIAS:
        b = tl.load(b_ptr + oc, mask=oc_mask, other=0.0)
        acc += b.to(tl.float32)[:, None]
    ptr_y = y_ptr + (n_idx[None, :] * y_sN) + (oc[:, None] * y_sC) + (d_idx[None, :] * y_sD) + (h_idx[None, :] * y_sH) + (w_idx[None, :] * y_sW)
    mask_y = (oc_mask[:, None]) & (m_mask[None, :])
    tl.store(ptr_y, acc, mask=mask_y)
